verdict.rationale: Clerk's pricing matrix lists "Passkeys — Authenticate with any form of passkeys" as a sign-in feature, and its site advertises email and SMS one-time passcodes with brute-force prevention. A changelog entry also lets passkeys serve as a second factor, so both halves of the story are covered by first-party claims. Passkeys are gated to the Pro plan and above, and the evidence is marketing- and pricing-level rather than in-depth setup docs. missing for 10: magic-link support evidence, detailed first-party docs on configuring passkey/OTP sign-in flows, independent or hands-on corroboration, passkey availability on the Free plan.
